title: KOICHA / Psyduck
tagline: The headache persists. The value accrues.
beats: Some conditions warrant permanent display.
Light finds the seam. Shadow finds the rest.
The migraine is the detail.
It has never known relief. It will outlast you.

title: Psyduck
tagline: The specimen cannot recall a pain-free state
beats: The species occupies vast negative space
Its shadow extends further than its mass
Vascular distress visible in the plumage
It waits. The headache does not subside.

title: The Psyduck
tagline: She had a headache that outlasted empires.
beats: The gallery was empty. So was I.
Forty years of cases. Never saw a shadow so long.
Stitching held. Most things don't.
She sat there waiting. They all do.

title: Psyduck
tagline: Friends say the headaches are back
beats: Exclusive: the first sighting in months
Insiders worried as shadows lengthen
The strain showing in every seam
Alone on the plinth: what happens now

title: Psyduck
tagline: Your head hurts. So does mine. Breathe.
beats:
Find a quiet room.
Leave the noise above.

Notice where the ache lives.
Do not push it away.

Touch the seam, the soft nap.
Even pain has texture.

You are here.
The headache is here.
